name: Osanai Sanae
source:
Seiichiro's childhood friend. She's actually also his blood related younger sister but that secret was kept from him until after they started having sex. [url=https://vndb.org/c7780]Tomomi[/url] tells him the truth early on however and instructs him to make her pregnant anyway. Because inbreeding with his sister will make his uniquely regressive genes more likely to manifest.

Her 'favorite number' is 15
